request.initial_prompt: Minerva led the way and Telemachus followed her. Presently she said, "Telemachus, you must not be in the least shy or nervous; you have taken this voyage to try and find out where your father is buried and how he came by his end; so go straight up to Nestor that we may see what he has got to tell us. Beg of him to speak the truth, and he will tell no lies, for he is an excellent person."

raw_segments.text: Minerva led the way and Telemachus followed her. Presently she said,
Telemachus, you must not be in the least shy or nervous. You have taken this voyage to try and
find out where your father is buried and how he came by his end. So go straight up to Nestor that
we may see what he has got to tell us. Beg of him to speak the truth, and he will tell no lies,
for he is an excellent person.
